source.title: 3 weeks' work in 1 day: How Schneider Electric serves customers faster

source_facts.fact: A sales representative completes a proposal before project matching and downstream processing.
The proposal is matched to an existing project.
Proposal data is transferred to an external database for processing and returned.
The external processing step handles up to 5,000 records at once.
Order fulfillment is automated after quoting completes.
Multiple customer cases describing the same product issue can be grouped into one issue.

validation_extensions.scenario: Submit 5,000 synthetic proposal lines and verify bounded chunking and one final aggregate.
Reconcile remote pricing success after a local timeout without creating another quote version.
Prevent fulfillment from a partially invalid batch and resume from corrected failed lines.
Concurrent conversion commands create one synthetic order and fulfillment set.
A worker restart resumes its lease without duplicate pricing or missing lines.
Concurrent synthetic support cases aggregate into one product issue with every source relation.

synthetic_data_policy: Use fictional organizations, products, people, identifiers, prices, and provider payloads; never copy customer data or branding into generated records.
